name: agent-standup
description: Watch your Claude Code session as a live, animated team call: the lead gives orders, sub-agents join, share their screen and report back — with voices, a sub-agent tree, timeline, recap and video export.

commands.title: Agent Standup: Open in browser (voice + sound)

agentStandup.port.description: Local port of the Agent Standup server. 0 (default) picks a free port automatically for each VS Code window.

agentStandup.autoOpen.description: Open the live call automatically when VS Code starts.

agentStandup.onlyThisWorkspace.description: Follow only Claude Code sessions started in the current workspace folder.

agentStandup.shareUsage.description: Help the project count active installs: once a day, send one empty request to a 1-pixel file on GitHub (no identifier, no content; GitHub sees your IP like for any download). Off by default; ignored if VS Code telemetry is off.

agentStandup.claudePath.description: Full path to the Claude Code executable, if it is not found automatically (used for French translation).
